---
title: "M14 - Hybrid Retrieval and RAG Component"
---

## Overview

Module M14 (Villanova Agata) defines a hybrid retrieval and grounding layer that combines semantic and lexical retrieval strategies for enterprise RAG pipelines.

## Business Capabilities

- Hybrid retrieval flows over multiple retrieval paradigms
- Engine and manager separation for execution versus governance
- Package and collection management for knowledge assets
- Configurable integration with Elasticsearch, Redis, and optional semantic analysis services
- Controlled access model through manager-mediated APIs and optional authentication

## Typical Adoption Scenarios

- M14 supports pilot adoption in business workflows where Hybrid Retrieval and RAG is required.
- The module can be integrated in composable platform journeys and assisted operations.
- Teams can start in standalone mode and scale to governed platform deployment.

## Business Value

- Reusable packaged capability that reduces custom implementation effort.
- Faster solution design by separating business configuration from runtime complexity.
- Better consistency across teams through a shared module contract and governance model.

## Ethical and Regulatory Considerations

- Human oversight remains required, especially for regulated or high-impact use cases.
- Organizations should apply transparency, traceability, and access controls for accountable operation.
- Risk controls should align with applicable regulatory obligations, including AI Act-related requirements where relevant.
